versions.subject: Merge PR #5689 from @swachchhanda000 - feat: usage or installation of wsl kali linux
versions.detection:
selection_wsl_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\wsl.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'wsl'
selection_wsl_install:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' --install '
        - ' -i '
selection_wsl_kali:
    CommandLine|contains: 'kali'
condition: all of selection_wsl_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\wsl.exe" OR OriginalFileName="wsl" CommandLine IN ("* --install *", "* -i *") CommandLine="*kali*"
